rounds.text: West Leisure Resorts Ltd is significantly under-appreciated because its asset backing provides a compelling margin of safety, trading at a price-to-book ratio of just 1.28x on a book value of ₹ 65.3 against a share price of ₹ 83.7 [E2], which even undercuts the broader sector benchmark price-to-book of 1.35x [E7]. The market is ignoring accelerating top-line momentum, demonstrated by a robust 24% compounded sales growth over 3 years [E16] and impressive recent screen signals highlighting year-over-year sales surges of +191% alongside profit growth exceeding 20% year-over-year [E58, E61]. Furthermore, this operational strength is actively translating into outperformance, as profit growth recently exceeds 1-year price growth by 267%, signaling that the company is starting to surpass market expectations [E53]. Conceded: [E1], [E4], [E5], [E6], [E8], [E17].
